topology_note: IP Phone -> SW1 Fa0/5 (should have voice vlan 10) -> CUCM
show_outputs: [show vlan brief]: VLAN Name Status Ports ---- -------------------------------- --------- ------------------------------- 1 default active Fa0/5 10 Voice active 20 Data active Fa0/6
expected_fault: Voice VLAN 10 not configured on access port Fa0/5 — phone defaulting to VLAN 1
expected_fix: SW1(config)# interface fa0/5 -> switchport access vlan 20 -> switchport voice vlan 10 -> switchport mode access -> spanning-tree portfast -> Verify: show interfaces fa0/5 switchport
verification: Post-fix show commands and ICMP echo verification

title: IP Routing Not Enabled on Multilayer Switch
symptom: MLS1 is a Layer 3 capable switch with SVIs configured for VLAN 10 and VLAN 20. Hosts in different VLANs cannot communicate even though SVIs are up/up.
topology_note: PC1 (VLAN 10) -> MLS1 (SVIs configured but ip routing disabled) -> PC2 (VLAN 20)
show_outputs: [show ip interface brief]: Interface IP-Address OK? Method Status Protocol Vlan10 192.168.10.1 YES manual up up Vlan20 192.168.20.1 YES manual up up | [show ip route]: Default gateway is 192.168.10.254 Network Next Hop * 0.0.0.0 192.168.10.254
expected_fault: 'ip routing' not enabled on multilayer switch — operating as Layer 2 switch only
expected_fix: MLS1(config)# ip routing -> Verify: show ip route (should show connected routes for SVIs) -> Test: ping 192.168.20.1 from VLAN 10 PC
verification: Post-fix show commands and ICMP echo verification
